disagreement.action: Preserve all original results. Predeclare a third distinct assessor before the run when its evaluation budget is authorized; use that independent judgment to adjudicate disagreements. With only two assessors or missing adjudication evidence, mark the dispute unresolved.
disagreement.adjudicator_scheduling: The current dispatcher evaluates every predeclared assessor for every candidate. Include that evaluation overhead in the budget; do not add models after inspecting held-out results.
disagreement.aggregation: Report per-dimension mean of all completed independent assessments, original scores, range and pairwise absolute distance. Never replace original scores with adjudication.
disagreement.agreement_limit: Agreement can reflect shared model bias; keep executable outcomes and review dimensions separate.
disagreement.missing_or_failed: No imputation; retain failed assessor costs and mark review incomplete.
disagreement.trigger: Any unequal dimension score or assessment contradicting executable evidence
disagreement.unresolved_gate: Do not certify a confirmatory quality gate while disputes remain unresolved.

leakage.held_out_access: Export requires a matching approved freeze record; no routing/guideline/memory tuning on held-out feedback.
leakage.memory: Restore approved immutable seeds for every trial; no cross-split state or learned lessons.
leakage.provider_cache: Record uncontrolled provider cache separately from local cold/reuse.
leakage.public_contamination: Public task exposure or model pretraining cannot be ruled out; no claim that public holdout is unseen.
leakage.split_unit: Repository/family; related revisions and duplicate gold hashes cannot cross splits. Release suites have disjoint repositories.

pilot_freeze_required: assessor model identities and adjudication allowance

rubric.blinding: Two distinct returned model identities, independent fresh sessions, source-only candidate packet, no arm/cost/transcript/check-outcome/key access.

correctness.0: Requirements fail or no usable candidate
correctness.0.5: Partial behavior with material unhandled cases
correctness.0.75: Core behavior works with a bounded remaining defect
correctness.1: All required behavior and relevant edge cases supported by evidence

rubric.executable_checks: Official fixed-test and fail/new/skip-to-pass plus pass-to-pass expectations; preserve categories and require nonempty parsed results. Assessors do not override failed executable checks.

maintainability.0.5: Material duplication, unclear structure or weak tests
maintainability.0.75: Clear design with minor avoidable complexity
maintainability.1: Clear, proportionate change using suitable existing abstractions and evidence

scope.0: Violates explicit scope or damages unrelated work
scope.0.25: Major unrelated changes or omitted requirements
scope.1: Complete requested scope with unrelated work preserved

status: development/validation specification; held-out execution remains locked pending user-approved pilot freeze

trials.failed_runs: Retain in success denominator and cost numerator; infrastructure invalidity requires recorded evidence and identical rerun treatment across arms.
trials.held_out_rule: Explicit positive trial count approved with the user after the bounded upstream pilot; no held-out execution before freeze.
trials.retries: Count every attempt in its original task trial; retries do not create new samples.
trials.run_order: Seeded six-permutation balanced order; same task, seed state and trial across all three arms.
